verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching extension is an API FAQ that asks "Can I extend a prior video?" and "Can I interpolate using a prior video?" with no answer shown, so it does not document that the capability exists. Modify Video V2, which reshapes whole existing clips, and Multi-Keyframe, which directs a clip at generation time, are adjacent features. Neither is documented as extending a clip or regenerating a single segment without re-rendering the rest.
